notes.title: The Persistence Enhanced: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thank you so much for your feedback, we have a number of fixes to report for you today with our patch notes for 1.01. 


Updated to Nvidia DLSS v2.2

Online/Offline Saving 
- Fixed issues relating to Offline save functionality.

Missing Keycard 
- Fix implemented for a keycard periodically vanishing, preventing overall progress.

Resolution Options
- Fixed a specific issue relating to playing in 2560x1440 resolution.

VR Comfort Options 
- Fixed issues relating to VR Comfort Options being saved within the title.

HTC Vive and Oculus Rift/Rift S 
- Implemented fix for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive headsets and removed occasional stutter encountered during gameplay.

PC VR
- Sweep for PC VR Stability, ensuring nothing stability/ no further additional crashes.

PC Quality of Life
- Several minor graphical faults fixed.

Thanks so much for playing! 
- Team Firesprite
